items.title: Himachal feels the chill under snow & rain

items.desc: Ukraine’s 'Operation Vivaldi' reclaimed more occupied territory in Donetsk during a week when Trump sided with Russia.

items.desc: Odisha Fire Services urges Durga Puja pandal organisers to get electrical safety checks, avoid combustible decor, ensure exits, and follow immersion safety guidelines.

items.desc: Bilaspur to set up Garamora mining check post at Punjab border to curb illegal mining; joint committee inspections, 160+ challans, 139 cases, hotspot monitoring.

items.title: Jantar Mantar solidarity rally held in Kochi
items.desc: Kochi held a ‘Chalo Jantar Mantar’ solidarity rally from Marine Drive to Rajendra Maidan backing calls for CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.

items.desc: Indian-American groups consider joint response after a 19-year-old is charged over an alleged mass-shooting plot targeting an Aurora Hindu temple near Chicago.

items.desc: “And thank God we have more money than they do, or else this could be curtains for Republicans,” Jesse Watters said.

items.desc: Punjab rice millers protest FCI Punjab’s order to deliver 3.13 LMT custom milled rice to surplus depots without transport costs, seek policy clarification.

items.title: Four members of Kharra family enter fray in Sikar local polls
items.desc: Four Kharra family members contest Sikar local body polls in Srimadhopur—two on BJP tickets, two as independents—fueling debate on dynastic politics.

items.title: Judge Threatens Trump with Sanctions in BBC Lawsuit
